steps.caption: A three.ws avatar, live in an embed
The number keys change her face
Retargeted onto her rig in the browser

posts.text:
This three.ws avatar takes requests. The number keys change her face, from a smile to a wink to surprise, and one click plays a move: a boxer dance, a superhero jump, a back flip.

Every clip is retargeted onto her own skeleton live in the browser, so the same library plays on any humanoid avatar you bring.

The embed is a real control surface for your site. Your page can make the avatar speak with lip sync, set any of the 52 ARKit face shapes, turn her head toward something, or hand her the webcam for live mocap.

Drop one into your own page: three.ws/docs/embedding
